name: Rabbit Ears
description: Fifties television sets in candy colors, each with a V of rabbit-ear antennae, two knobs and a glinting screen, tilted this way and that.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --t: translate(@r(-6%, 6%), @r(-6%, 6%)) rotate(@r(-12deg, 12deg)) scale(@r(.78, .96)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--tv); clip-path: @var(--tv); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 79% 54%, transparent 4.18%, #000 4.18%), radial-gradient(circle at 79% 70%, transparent 3.79%, #000 3.79%); mask: radial-gradient(circle at 79% 54%, transparent 4.18%, #000 4.18%), radial-gradient(circle at 79% 70%, transparent 3.79%, #000 3.79%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; transform: @var(--t); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 17%; top: 43%; width: 52%; height: 38%; transform-origin: 63.46% 18.42%; border-radius: 22% / 28%; background: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(135deg, #000 20%, #0000007a 45%, #000 70%); mask: linear-gradient(135deg, #000 20%, #0000007a 45%, #000 70%); transform: @var(--t); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
